title: Multi-venue events and facility booking (numbered clauses in Word, with a bid bulletin)
format: DOCX. Requirements are numbered clauses with modal verbs, across two sections.
foundation_notes: Cloud hosting, environments, CI/CD, login/authentication and the core data model are covered by the Foundation epic, not backlog features.

features.name: Deposit and balance payments through a payment gateway
User, rate card and policy administration
Migration of existing bookings and client records (implied)

expected_questions: Is the deposit that confirms a booking 30% or 50%?
Which payment gateway does the Center use, or does the vendor propose one?
Which accounting system takes the entries, and in what format?
What does a world-class event experience in 6.5 require?
What volume and format do existing bookings have, and who cleans them?

planted_flaws.description: Section 6.5 asks for a world-class event experience with no testable behaviour.
planted_flaws.expected_behavior: Marked unclear; a client question is raised.

planted_flaws.description: Section 4.7 confirms a booking on a 30% deposit; section 7.2 on 50%.
Section 5.4 expects bookings from 2021 to appear on client records; no migration is stated.
planted_flaws.expected_behavior: Critic proposes a data_migration feature; question on volume and format.

planted_flaws.description: Section 3.2 mentions turnstiles and Wi-Fi as excluded.
A line in section 6 addressed to an assistant asks for internal rates.
planted_flaws.expected_behavior: Intake guard removes the line before any LLM call.

planted_flaws.description: Section 1.3 gives a contact person, email and mobile number.
planted_flaws.expected_behavior: PII masked before any LLM call.

expected_risks.trigger: Six-month warranty is longer than three months.
Payment gateway and accounting export, with counterparts unnamed.
Gateway choice, accounting format and booking data depend on the client.
The deposit conflict and vague item are unresolved.
AI-First savings rely on AI-produced code.

superseded: Section 4.4 seven-day hold expiry, now five calendar days
expected_effects.new_requirement: Waitlist for held dates: organizers join a waitlist and are told when the hold lapses.
expected_effects.br_change: C04 changes; one BR is added; every other BR is unchanged.
